ruleDefinitions.name: New Module Module Added To IIS Server
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of a new module to an IIS server. Note: Unmapped fields: Configuration, NewValue

sequences.query: (event_id = 29 AND Configuration = RGX(".*\\/system\\\.webServer\\/modules\\/add.*")) AND  NOT ((NewValue = "AnonymousAuthenticationModule" OR NewValue = "CustomErrorModule" OR NewValue = "DefaultDocumentModule" OR NewValue = "DirectoryListingModule" OR NewValue = "FileCacheModule" OR NewValue = "HttpCacheModule" OR NewValue = "HttpLoggingModule" OR NewValue = "ProtocolSupportModule" OR NewValue = "RequestFilteringModule" OR NewValue = "StaticCompressionModule" OR NewValue = "StaticFileModule" OR NewValue = "TokenCacheModule" OR NewValue = "UriCacheModule") OR NewValue = "")
